   - `from-white` in gradients → `from-background`

   - Any `bg-white` on cards/inputs → `bg-card`

9. `src/pages/Pricing.tsx`
   - Any `bg-white` → `bg-card` (where appropriate for card backgrounds)

10. `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx`
    - Any `bg-white` → `bg-card`

**Rules:**
- Only replace `bg-white` that is used for card/panel backgrounds
- Do NOT replace `bg-white` inside SVG elements or icon circles (those are intentional)
- Do NOT replace `text-white` — those are for white text on dark backgrounds
- Read each file first before editing
